extension.summary: Duotone - every picture printed in its section's colour.
extension.description: A loud, graphic poster-design skin. Films are vermilion, series cobalt, music acid green: every image in a section is a one-colour print on a halftone field, and the focused item alone bursts into full colour. Giant condensed type, thick rules, a strict grid. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.5 - Series info: "Last ep" date when no episode is scheduled. v0.9.4 - "Ends 1:52 AM" on the OSD and seek bar; series info shows the next episode date (TMDb Helper). v0.9.3 - Home column hops (Down/Up), OSD without seek buttons (Play, Stop first), fitted OSD time and info stats, no header judder. v0.9.1 - Fitted Anton mastheads: long titles step down a size or wrap to fixed lines instead of scrolling. v0.9.0 - First build.
